env_allowlist.PATH: runner-provided helper discovery; Lean, the Lake launcher, and Bubblewrap are content-hash checked, while the incomplete helper TCB prevents release credit
env_allowlist.HOME: runner-provided only for Lake/Elan discovery; inner Lean sandbox overrides HOME with a fresh temporary directory

network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs with --trust=0 inside Bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, a writable fresh temporary module directory, a fixed temporary HOME, C.UTF-8 locale, UTC timezone, umask 022, and one Lean worker thread. The pinned dependency cache is reused read-only, so this is warm node evidence rather than release-grade cold hermetic reproduction.
status_boundary: The recipe validates the exact frozen statement, conditional package composition, ten partial exponent bodies, and four separately written normalization/composition probes. No complete M1024-N-EXPONENT body or forward, converse, uniqueness, or exact-root inhabitant exists; complete trust/provenance, cold hermetic replay, and distinct-runner verification are not claimed.
